newsitem.title: UK: British children set largest orchestra record.
newsitem.headline: British children set largest orchestra record.

text.p: More than 2,800 children playing a specially composed piece of music set a record on Thursday as the world's largest orchestra.

The 2,854 youngsters from all over Britain, pounded drums, strummed instruments and blew into horns, trumpets and oboes, as conductor Sir Simon Rattle kept them in harmony for the 15-minute rendition of a piece called "Let Music Live."
British actor and musician Dudley Moore conceived the idea after providing the voice for a piano cartoon character called Oscar who promotes music for children.
The previous record for the largest orchestra was 2,023 musicians from various orchestras throughout Britain who performed on July 14 this year.
